# Writes .harness/done/<role>.<ask-id> (ask-id from .harness/asks/<role>.current,
# written by `harness ask`). Workers only (HARNESS_ROLE=worker); never fatal.
mark_done() {
  local role=$1 input=$2 id sid tmp

  case "$role" in analyst|implementer|reviewer) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  id=$(awk 'NR==1 { print $1 }' ".harness/asks/$role.current" 2>/dev/null)

cmd_stop() {

newrepo() {

      && echo seed > seed.txt && git add seed.txt && git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null commit -q -m seed )

hv() { OUT=$(cd "$R" && /bin/bash "$VERIFY" "$@" 2>/dev/null </dev/null); RC=$?; }
